title: Mobile UX optimization: P5 roadmap + responsive fixes across 9 components
body:
Most plugin views (Grid, Kanban, Dashboard, Calendar, Timeline) had zero responsive Tailwind classes — they assumed desktop viewports with hardcoded widths, fixed heights, and non-wrapping toolbars.

## ROADMAP.md — P5 Mobile User Experience

Added ~80 actionable items across 6 sub-sections: Plugin Views, Console Pages, Core Primitives, Mobile Infrastructure, Testing & QA, and Success Metrics. Updated executive summary, priority list, success criteria, and risk table.

## Responsive component fixes

- **DataTable** — Toolbar stacks vertically on mobile (`flex-col sm:flex-row`), search goes full-width, pagination wraps, table container gets touch-scroll
- **DashboardRenderer** — Replaced hardcoded `gridTemplateColumns: repeat(4, ...)` inline style with `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4`; widget padding scales `p-3 sm:p-4 md:p-6`
- **KanbanImpl** — Column width `w-72 sm:w-80`, gap/padding scale with breakpoints, touch-scroll on board container
- **ObjectCalendar** — Height: `h-[calc(100vh-120px)] sm:h-[calc(100vh-160px)] md:h-[calc(100vh-200px)]`, min-height `400px sm:600px`
- **DetailView** — Header stacks on mobile (`flex-col sm:flex-row`), title `text-xl sm:text-2xl`, action buttons wrap
- **ListView** — Toolbar padding `px-2 sm:px-4`, search `w-36 sm:w-48 lg:w-64`, filter/sort popovers `w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:w-[600px]`
- **TimelineRenderer** — Horizontal and Gantt variants get `overflow-x-auto [-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch]`
- **ObjectGrid/ObjectForm** — Error/loading states use `p-3 sm:p-4` / `p-4 sm:p-8`

```tsx
// Before: hardcoded 4-column grid, breaks on mobile
<div style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>

// After: responsive Tailwind classes, inline style only for >4 columns
<div className="grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4"
     style={columns > 4 ? { gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, minmax(0, 1fr))` } : undefined}>
```

All 399 tests across 45 test files pass, including 11 responsive layout assertion tests. Zero CodeQL alerts.
